escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in the world this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6, by MrBeast Gaming, with over 774 thousand likes.
In second place, MY FIRST DAY IN VICE CITY | GTA 6 GAMEPLAY, by Techno Gamerz, with over 1 million likes.
And number one: Avengers: Doomsday | Final Trailer | In Theaters…, by Marvel Entertainment, with over 1 million likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
